weaknesses.point: Operating profit converts poorly into cash.
Inventory tie up a lot of cash.
Cash stays locked in the working-capital cycle for a long time.
The stock carries a very rich earnings multiple.
Working capital intensity is on the higher side.
The price is many times the accounting book value.
Earnings follow a seasonal cycle rather than a steady line.

A capital goods tailwind can lift earnings without the company doing anything different.
Continued promoter buying signals confidence in what is coming.
Historically strong quarters (Mar, Sep) are still in the cycle.
